headline: Bank of Japan Pauses Interest Rates While Signaling Potential December Rate Hike
summary: The Bank of Japan kept interest rates unchanged but maintained a hawkish stance that leaves room for a rate increase in December.
why: The Bank of Japan is the country's central bank, whose monetary policy impacts global yields and foreign exchange rates.

impacts.name: Japanese Yen
impacts.why: A hawkish central bank pause signals potential policy tightening at the upcoming December meeting.

why_moved: The BOJ held interest rates steady but signaled readiness to hike rates in December.
